messages:
maya: Noticed 3 low-impact OOMs overnight in the kv pool, all during compaction bursts. Opening this thread to convert the postmortem TODOs into concrete owners/timelines. :mag: 

jordi: Ack. From the PM: short-term guardrails (compaction concurrency cap + abort-on-low-mem), medium-term RCA (heapshots + jemalloc arena analysis), and telemetry backfill to detect recurrence.

sam: I'll prototype a soft cap + abort behind a flag. Plan: dark metrics for 12h, then canary 2 hosts at 1% traffic. ETA 14h for branch + tests.

lina: I'll take the profiling/RCA. Plan: heap snapshots pre/during/post compaction, jemalloc stats (je_*), and pinned-span checks. ETA: 4 working days for initial RCA.

ops-bot: Created ticket INF-3560 "kv: compaction-related memory surge follow-ups" assigned to sam,lina. Priority: P1. Link: https://tickets/internal/INF-3560

jordi: Short checklist with owners/due:
- Sam: feature-flag cap + rollout plan / due 14h
- Lina: profiling plan + data collection / due 4d
- Jordi: dashboard & backfill (compaction.rate, free_pages.p10/p50/p90) / due 24h
- Maya: coordinate canary/capacity ops / due 24h

sam: Example repro commands for staging:
"./run_repro --qps 60 --duration 45m --compact-interval 30s --heap-snapshot=60s"
I'll also collect flamegraphs and jeprof outputs.

lina: RCA checklist: heap histogram diffs, jemalloc active vs allocated, check for pinned arenas, regression window for allocator/compaction heuristics. Will backfill 60 days.

jordi: Dashboard metrics to add: kv.compact.count, kv.compact.concurrent, kv.compact.abort_count, kv.live_pages.p95, host.free_pages.p10. Will overlay compaction events on host free memory.

sam: Rollout plan: flag-only dark metrics -> canary 2 hosts with abort threshold at free_mem<10% -> expand if stable. Rollback: flip flag off + drain in-flight compactions.

maya: Action: schedule a short findings demo after RCA (owners: lina+sam). Target date: 2025-01-19.

ops-bot: Backfill job scheduled: backfill-kv-compact-2025-03-10 (60d)

sam: Status update: branch pushed, unit tests green, enabling dark metrics in ~6h.

lina: Status update: profiling plan posted, starting heapshots tonight. Blocker: need staging long-run quota.

jordi: Status update: dashboard draft posted, will add alerts after backfill completes.

maya: We'll use this thread for daily 1-line updates until INF-3560 is closed. Keep updates short (done / blocker). If urgent, ping me directly. :thumbsup:
